summary: Non-compliance of absorption order; deceased employee deemed absorbed from 12.02.1990 notionally; family pension and salary arrears to be determined via fact-finding enquiry; directions to Registrar/Vice Chancellor for adjudication; prior contempt orders not binding on family pension; appeal disposed with procedural directions.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Bihar & others vs Bihar Rajya M.S.E.S.K.K.M & others (2005) 9 SCC 129
final_judgment: Contempt petitions disposed of; directions issued for adjudication of salary arrears and family pension by Registrar/Vice Chancellor; liberty to approach High Court against orders.
